content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Clifftop temple with cheeky monkeys and a view that makes you forget your name."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A proper plate of Balinese chicken rice, halal and full of local hustle."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The carved doors alone are worth a slow look, and the courtyard feels a world away from the street."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the stalls for bright textiles and little carvings, and try a friendly haggle."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Start with the ridge walk while the air is still cool and the views stretch wide."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Slip into the carved cave and let the old stone faces do the talking."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"The monkeys run the show here, so keep your sunglasses close and your snacks hidden."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Lotus ponds and carved stone make this temple feel like a quiet secret in the middle of town."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"The sunbeams through the canyon are pure magic, so bring your sense of wonder and maybe a towel."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Those emerald terraces ripple like a green ocean, and the local farmers still work them by hand."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Holy spring water, ancient stone carvings, and a chance to watch Balinese prayers up close."}]}
Soft Ubud landing, ridges, rivers, falls and rice, a clifftop temple by the sea, then one lazy goodbye morning — all the good stuff's in.
